language.title: Interface language

language.label: Language

server.title: Server
server.description: The base URL of your FreePlex server.

streaming.title: Streaming quality
streaming.description: Separate bitrate caps for local and external/mobile connections. The active cap is sent to the server as maxBitrateKbps. Use 0 for no limit.

player.title: Player
player.description: Default quality mode when starting playback.

libraries.title: Libraries
libraries.description: Paths inside the server container. Use separate folders or one shared /media — files stay in place; scan classifies by filename.
libraries.name: Name
libraries.pathHint: Same path on Movies and Series is fine. Episode names need SxxExx (or 1x02).
libraries.enrichHint: Language affects TMDB titles/overviews. For English filenames, en-US usually matches better.

serverAdmin.title: Server settings
serverAdmin.description: Transcoding limits, metadata language, provider keys, and import watcher.
serverAdmin.metadataHint: Changing metadata language re-fetches titles and overviews for matched items.
serverAdmin.providersHint: TVMaze works without a key (series only). TMDB and TVDB need free keys after registration.
serverAdmin.tmdbKeyHelp: Get a free key at themoviedb.org
serverAdmin.keyConfiguredPlaceholder: Key saved — enter a new one to replace
serverAdmin.keysHint: Keys are never returned by the API. Stored in /config/metadata-secrets.json (or set via env).
